title: Xila registry root (experimental v1)
description: root.json in xila-project/registry, signed offline (root.json.sig) by a root key: the pinned key for the first version, then a root key of the previous version. Names the keys allowed to sign the next root and the repository keys that sign the index, entries and developer keys. A key may not hold both roles.

$schema.description: Optional editor-facing schema URL; not a trust anchor.

version.description: Strictly increasing; devices refuse a lower or equal version.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key in canonical base64.

root_keys.description: Keys allowed to sign the next root version.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key in canonical base64.

repository_keys.description: Online keys that sign index.json, entries and developer keys.
